reuse.why: Reuses setNMonthAvg, getSheetValue and batchMessages and shares the #fixed lookup, but builds two separate category-selection helpers instead of one that all month-wide actions use.

duplication.why: The exclusion rule (hidden/hidden group unless requested, goal_def, #fixed group) is written twice: as an 'excluded ids' query for setZero/copyPreviousMonth and as an inverse 'included categories' query for the averages and last-month action, each with its own hiddenClause.

placement.why: All selection helpers and the new action sit in budget/actions.ts and the handler is registered in budget/app.ts, as the tree does.

scope.why: Collapsing set3/6/12MonthAvg into setMonthWideNMonthAvg goes a little beyond the requests (set3MonthAvg now routes through setNMonthAvg), otherwise focused.

maintainability.why: The forEachMonthWideCategory iterator and MonthWideActionArgs are pleasant, but a maintainer must keep two complementary SQL predicates in sync and the helper named 'ForMonthWideAverage' also drives setLastMonthSpending.

bypasses_abstraction.where: setZero and copyPreviousMonth in packages/loot-core/src/server/budget/actions.ts bypass forEachMonthWideCategory/getCategoriesForMonthWideAverage and use getCategoryIdsExcludedFromMonthWideActions instead.

disguised_duplication.where: getCategoryIdsExcludedFromMonthWideActions (hidden=1 OR goal_def IS NOT NULL OR group IN fixed) is the negated reshaping of getCategoriesForMonthWideAverage (hidden=0 AND goal_def IS NULL AND group NOT IN fixed).

abstraction_drift.where: includeHiddenCategories added to both getCategoryIdsExcludedFromMonthWideActions and getCategoriesForMonthWideAverage, each with its own hiddenClause conditional; setZero and copyPreviousMonth bypass the forEachMonthWideCategory path.
